name: tech-agency
description: Multi-agent software development framework — 19 specialized agents, 48 skills, and 18 rule files covering Android, iOS, KMP, Web, and backend development, plus a companion marketing agency.

plugins.name: tech-agency
plugins.description: 19 specialized agents (Atlas, Kai, Swift, Nova, Link, Forge, Pyra, Flux, Shield, Sage, Morgan, Diana, Pixel, Apex, Sentinel, Scroll, Echo, Neuron, Pipeline) and 48 skills — 34 first-party workflow skills for feature development, PR creation, code review, health checks and releases, plus 14 vendored Apache-2.0 agent skills from Google (android-*) and JetBrains (kotlin-*) that install alongside them. Ships 18 rule files: 10 shared rules copied into your repo by /setup-repo, and 8 coding standards read on demand from the plugin.

plugins.name: marketing-agency
plugins.description: Proactive, self-improving marketing system that complements tech-agency. Runs funnel audits, proposes experiments, hands engineering work to tech-agency, turns releases into launch content, and teaches the marketing craft as it works (mentor mode).
